questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

I studied a book on the __study of stars__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e**. 'Astronomy'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"The study of stars"** refers to the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole. (तारों का अध्ययन)

 
 
• **Example: **She is interested in the study of stars and planets.
 
 
 
• "Astronomy" is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole, so it is a suitable one-word substitute for the phrase "the study of stars".(ज्योतिर्विज्ञान).
 
 
• **Example:** He has a keen interest in astronomy.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"Geology"** is the science that deals with the earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it.(भूविज्ञान) 
 
• Option 3, **"Astrophysics"** is the branch of astronomy that deals with the physical properties of celestial bodies and with the interaction between matter and radiation in the interior of celestial bodies and in interstellar space.(ताराभौतिकी)
 
• Option 4, **"Meteorology"** is the scientific study of the atmosphere and its phenomena, especially in relation to weather and weather forecasting.(मौसम विज्ञान)

options.text: have been acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution.

• The phrase in question is ‘**is acquiring serious dimensions was noise pollution.**'
 
• The verb '**was**' in the underlined segment should be replaced with '**is**' to make the sentence grammatically consistent and meaningful.
 
• The correct phrase should be '**is acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution,**' implying that noise pollution is a new kind of pollution that is currently gaining serious dimensions.
 
• Options 1 and 4 both use '**have been**' and '**have**,' which are incorrect in this context as pollution in the phrase is singular.

Therefore, the correct answer is:** Option 2.**

**Correct Sentence:* ****A new kind of pollution that **is acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution**.*

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

The immense talent / we having at our disposal is / impressive to say the least.

options.text: we having at our disposal is

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **we having at our disposal is**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in the use of "**we having**," and it should be corrected to "**we have**" for proper subject-verb agreement and tense consistency.
 
• The correct phrase is "**we have**" to ensure agreement between the subject ("**we**") and the verb ("**have**").
 
• "Having" implies a continuous action, but in this context, a simple present tense is more appropriate.
 
• Therefore, "we have" is the correct form.
 
• The **corrected sentence** "*The immense talent we have at our disposal is impressive to say the least*" is clearer and grammatically accurate.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

• **Cattle; kettle. **This is the **correct option. **

• Also, tea is commonly served in a kettle, which is a container for boiling water and brewing tea.
 
 
 
 
 
• So, the sentence would read:* *__**__*"Cattle*__ are the prime resource of a country and a tea is served in a*__ kettle."__***
